definition: Deterministic capability coverage, not incident recall or upstream uptime. Modeled, satellite, advice, and discovery/context providers cannot satisfy monitoring.

reclassifications.explanation: EEA AQI remains visible but is partial: only observation-backed culprit pollutants can create monitoring evidence; modeled or gap-filled values are context and never all-clear.

priorityProgram.definition: One row per country/hazard capability gap; forecasts, advice, satellite detections, modeled conditions, and fallback-only transports do not create warning coverage.

candidates.blocker: The documented reader API requires an authority-issued key and contract validation.

candidates.blocker: Gateway is JSON discovery with linked CAP. A sampled Actual/Public Alert was registration confirmation (event Test, Unknown severity), not an emergency. Website terms do not establish all gateway issuer rights. Need real emergency taxonomy/geometry, updates/cancellations and complete-query semantics; do not publish registration prose.
candidates.reReviewTrigger: Applicable gateway/issuer reuse and representative real emergency lifecycle fixtures.

candidates.blocker: Official location RSS returned empty HTTP 200 feeds with old channel publication dates. candidates.reReviewTrigger: Representative emergency/update/cancel RSS plus applicable issuer reuse and exact district matching.
